outline_note: No square-on photo of a modern fiddle with a licence we can use turned up (Commons was rate-limited from the cloud and maker sites are blocked); Bean's photo is at an angle. Outline is reported only; a square-on photo of the J/22's vang blocks would let it be checked.

features.text: Fiddle: the big sheave under the head and a smaller one in line below it, so the big sheave's lines pass outside the narrow lower cheeks
Moulded cheeks: round round the big sheave, a flat head above, narrowing round the small sheave
Cheeks matte black plastic, metal parts bright stainless
Hollow centre on the big sheave: a stainless axle you can see through
The small sheave on a riveted pin (a domed head on each cheek)
Lightening holes round both axles and shoulder windows, sheave showing through
Swivel post with a collar on the head
Shackle with a pin and a pin head
Maker's plate (made-up TERNWAY, never a real brand)

budget.note: about 1.2 single blocks (Block40's 20k); build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter
